import ast
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys

repo = Path('/Users/dli/dev/libdxfrw')
scratch = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
mapping = Path('/private/tmp/libdxfrw-deeper-readiness.cvvmLR/8859-4.TXT')
windows_source = mapping.parent / 'CP1257.TXT'

def parse_source(path):
    result = {}
    for line in path.read_text().splitlines():
        fields = line.split('#',1)[0].split()
        if len(fields) >= 2:
            result[int(fields[0],16)] = int(fields[1],16)
    return result

def array(text,name):
    body = re.search(r'\b' + re.escape(name) + r'\s*(?:\[128\]|\[\])\s*=\s*\{(.*?)\};', text, re.S).group(1)
    body = re.sub(r'//[^\n]*','',body)
    return [int(value,16) for value in re.findall(r'0x[0-9a-fA-F]+',body)]

source = parse_source(mapping)
assert len(source) == len(set(source.values())) == 256
header = repo / 'src/intern/drw_cptable_iso8859_4.h'
upper = array(header.read_text(),'DRW_TableISO8859_4')
assert len(upper) == 128
test_text = (repo/'tests/gbk_codepage_tests.cpp').read_text().split('void testExactIso8859_4(',1)[1]
graphic = array(test_text,'graphic')
windows = array(test_text,'windows')
assert len(graphic) == 96 and len(windows) == 128
for byte in range(256):
    expected = ord(bytes([byte]).decode('iso8859_4',errors='strict'))
    assert source[byte] == expected
    assert (byte if byte < 128 else upper[byte-128]) == expected
    assert (byte if byte < 160 else graphic[byte-160]) == expected
win_source = parse_source(windows_source)
assert len(win_source) == 244
for byte in range(128,256):
    try: expected = ord(bytes([byte]).decode('cp1257',errors='strict'))
    except UnicodeDecodeError: expected = 0
    assert windows[byte-128] == expected == win_source.get(byte,0)
cases = [(mapping,header,0), (scratch/'invalid-source.txt',header,1),
         (mapping,scratch/'invalid-header.h',1)]
for input_path,check_path,expected in cases:
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(repo/'tools/generate_iso8859_4.py'),
                             str(input_path),'--check',str(check_path)],
                            capture_output=True,timeout=5)
    assert result.returncode == expected and len(result.stdout)+len(result.stderr)<65536
notice = repo/'LICENSES/Unicode-3.0.txt'
assert hashlib.sha256(notice.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'e7a93b009565cfce55919a381437ac4db883e9da2126fa28b91d12732bc53d96'
assert 'src/intern/drw_cptable_iso8859_4.h' in (repo/'libdxfrw_sources.cmake').read_text()
assert 'intern/drw_cptable_iso8859_4.h' in (repo/'src/Makefile.am').read_text()
assert 'LICENSES/Unicode-3.0.txt' in (repo/'Makefile.am').read_text()
tree = ast.parse((repo/'conanfile.py').read_text())
exports = [node for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node,ast.Assign)
           and any(isinstance(target,ast.Name) and target.id=='exports_sources' for target in node.targets)]
assert len(exports)==1 and 'LICENSES/**' in ast.literal_eval(exports[0].value)
assert hashlib.sha256((repo/'src/intern/drw_cptables.h').read_bytes()).hexdigest() == '76cbf82944d5a33a5e770dc8f469a1a2e360348f80c8fa5732ef66fb1a5c10a0'
subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check'],cwd=repo,check=True,timeout=5)
print('ISO8859-4 QA: PASS (256 source/CPython/production/test scalar agreements,128 Windows source/test upper rows,3 generator controls,notice/source manifests/Conan export,unchanged historical tables)')
